result.summary: The intersection is located in a residential area and lacks essential pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks, curb ramps, and pedestrian signals. While traffic lights are present for vehicles, the wide roadway and discontinuous sidewalks create a hostile environment for people walking.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks at this signalized intersection, leaving pedestrians without a designated path across a wide roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: The intersection has vehicle signals but no dedicated pedestrian signal heads to indicate safe crossing times.
hazards.location_in_image: At the signal poles on the corners.

hazards.name: Discontinuous Sidewalks
hazards.description: Sidewalks are not present on all corners, potentially forcing pedestrians to walk in the roadway to reach their destination.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the side street and along the foreground roadway.

interventions.title: Install High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Paint continental or ladder-style crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way and improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Add Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on crossing time and improve safety at the signalized intersection.

interventions.title: ADA Compliant Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install curb ramps with detectable warning surfaces at all crossing points to ensure accessibility for all users.

result.summary: The intersection lacks basic pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks, sidewalks, and pedestrian signals, despite being controlled by traffic lights for vehicles. The wide roadway and residential context suggest a high-speed environment that is hostile to people walking.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Crossing Infrastructure
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals at this signalized intersection, forcing pedestrians to cross unprotected.
hazards.location_in_image: Center intersection area

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalks
hazards.description: No continuous paved walkways are visible along the main roadway, forcing pedestrians to walk in the street or on unpaved shoulders.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the main road

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Large trees on the corner may obstruct sight lines between drivers and pedestrians attempting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the intersection

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks and Pedestrian Signals
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalk markings and pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide a dedicated phase for crossing.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Construct continuous ADA-compliant sidewalks on both sides of the street to separate pedestrians from vehicular traffic.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to reduce the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection with minimal pedestrian infrastructure, lacking marked crosswalks and consistent sidewalks. While a flashing beacon and warning sign are present, the wide roadway and lack of physical separation or designated crossing space create a high-exposure environment for pedestrians.

hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks at this intersection despite the presence of a pedestrian warning beacon, leaving pedestrians unprotected while crossing.

hazards.description: Sidewalks appear narrow and do not provide a continuous, clear path for pedestrians on all sides of the intersection.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb may block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian space and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to reduce crossing distance, slow turning traffic, and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install detectable warning surfaces and sloped ramps at all crossing points to ensure accessibility.

result.summary: The intersection is heavily prioritized for motor vehicles, lacking basic pedestrian safety features such as marked crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and ADA-compliant curb ramps. While traffic lights control vehicle flow, the absence of designated crossing infrastructure creates a hostile environment for people on foot.
